scope: Original fixed integer trees and the prescribed signed-capacity rooted-pruning family; exact finite DP for weighted error and the actual positive-energy budget. No claim of optimality among all compressions, no new arithmetic road or asymptotic estimate.

arithmetic.method: outward integer intervals; exact rational geometry

node_cost: Number of retained kernel nodes in a rooted pruning: expanded nodes plus frontier nodes. This is a representation count, not a number of newly computed arithmetic moments.

formulas.exact_error_cost: ||V_F-S||_w^2=sum_(p in F)||r_p||_w^2 by disjoint frontier interiors
formulas.node_dp: D_p(k)=min{cost_p, min_(1+k_l+k_r<=k)(D_l(k_l)+D_r(k_r))}; cost_p may be exact weighted error or exact positive-energy excess Delta_p
formulas.budget: (sqrt(interior positive energy of J+V_F)+sqrt(original fine remainder positive energy))^2+original endpoint squares
formulas.optional_intersection: min(Z,V_F) remains an upper envelope; it consumes the pre-existing full Z as well as the frontier representation and is not counted as a k-node representation
